Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The old URL /educacion/evaluacion-e-informacion-educativa redirects here. The page lists "Datos abiertos: Bases de datos de Aprender y Relevamiento Anual", "Reportes por escuela: Plataforma de microdatos por escuela", "Padrón Nacional de Establecimientos Educativos", and SICDIE, the indicators query system. Licence checked 2026-10-31: the footer line "Los contenidos de Argentina.gob.ar están licenciados bajo Creative Commons Atribución 4.0 Internacional", quoted here earlier, sits inside an HTML comment on the page and is not displayed. The evidence instead: the site's terms (https://www.argentina.gob.ar/terminos-y-condiciones) say "El Administrador licencia todos sus contenidos bajo la licencia Creative Commons Atribución 4.0 Internacional… excepto cuando se declare lo contrario", and on datos.gob.ar the Aprender datasets (educacion-aprender-2019, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024) are listed with license_id CC-BY-4.0.

entries.title: INEP Microdata (Brazil)

coverage.spatial: Brazil (school, institution, and individual level, de-identified)
coverage.temporal: varies by survey (multiple decades for the School Census)

entries.license: CC-BY (INEP's dataset listings on dados.gov.br; version unspecified; the gov.br/inep site footer says CC-BY-ND-3.0)
entries.attribution: INEP — Instituto Nacional de Estudos e Pesquisas Educacionais Anísio Teixeira
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page lists microdata for the Censo Escolar, the Censo da Educação Superior, Enade, and other INEP surveys and exams. It notes that file formats are being restructured to remove the possibility of identifying individuals. The INEP Dados Abertos page states "Todo o conteúdo deste site está publicado sob a licença Creative Commons Atribuição-SemDerivações 3.0 Não Adaptada" (CC BY-ND 3.0). That is a site-wide statement. The csv/zip formats come from INEP's usual distribution and weren't checked.
Licence checked 2026-10-31: INEP's own listings on dados.gov.br mark the microdata "Creative Commons Attribution" (licence id cc-by, no version given): for example "Microdados públicos do Censo Escolar da Educação Básica" (https://dados.gov.br/dados/conjuntos-dados/inep-microdados-do-censo-escolar-da-educacao-basica, metadata updated 24/02/2026), and likewise the Censo da Educação Superior, Enem, Saeb, Enade, Encceja and ANA. The Enamed microdata are listed as cc-zero. The dataset-level declaration is taken over the site footer's CC BY-ND 3.0.

entries.title: Colombia ICFES DataIcfes (national exam microdata)
entries.description: DataIcfes is the data repository of Colombia's Instituto Colombiano para la Evaluación de la Educación. It holds anonymised results databases from the national exams (Saber 3°, 5°, 7° and 9°, Saber 11°, Saber TyT, Saber Pro and others), with evaluees' socioeconomic information, for research on education quality.
entries.publisher: Instituto Colombiano para la Evaluación de la Educación (ICFES)

access.auth_note: Registration (a Microsoft Forms request linked as "Regístrate al DataIcfes") to obtain DataIcfes access credentials

coverage.spatial: Colombia (student, school and higher-education-institution level)
coverage.temporal: varies by exam (the Saber 11 file on datos.gov.co covers 2010-2022)

entries.license: unverified — the DataIcfes page states no licence; ICFES's own exam datasets on Colombia's open data portal (datos.gov.co) are labelled CC-BY-SA-4.0
entries.attribution: Instituto Colombiano para la Evaluación de la Educación (ICFES), DataIcfes
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl and headless Chromium). The issue saw the DataIcfes path redirect to the homepage; this session https://www.icfes.gov.co/investigaciones/data-icfes/ loaded directly, reached from the "Investigaciones" page ("Ir a DataIcfes"). It reads "¡Nos renovamos! Accede a las bases de datos de las distintas pruebas aplicadas" and "¡Realiza el registro para crear tus nuevas credenciales de acceso!". The registration button links to a Microsoft Forms page (forms.office.com). It reports "6 Pruebas", "644 bases de datos anonimizadas", "10985 Establecimientos educativos" and "260 Instituciones Educativas de Educación Superior". The FAQ says files are ".txt (o archivos planos)" delimited by «|» or similar, and mentions a file "que nos envió en el primer correo". So delivery may be partly by email; how it works after registration was not checked, and the portal behind the login was not seen (no account was created). The page also links a data inventory and publication calendar (as images).
ICFES also publishes some exam files itself on Colombia's open data portal (Socrata), for example "Resultados únicos Saber 11" (https://www.datos.gov.co/d/kgxf-xxbe, attribution "Instituto Colombiano para la Evaluación de la Educación - ICFES", 7,109,704 rows, periods 20101-20224, updated 2023-08-23), plus Saber Pro and Saber TyT. Those are not the canonical home and were not catalogued separately.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: no licence or terms of use appear on the DataIcfes page (the footer reads "Copyright 2021 - Todos los derechos reservados Gobierno de Colombia"). The datos.gov.co metadata for ICFES's Saber datasets gives "Creative Commons Attribution | Share Alike 4.0 International". That may not cover data obtained through DataIcfes, so the licence is left unverified.

entries.title: IEA PIRLS International Database (Progress in International Reading Literacy Study)
entries.description: Student, home, teacher and school microdata and reading achievement scores from IEA's PIRLS assessments of fourth-grade reading every five years from 2001 to 2021, including ePIRLS and PIRLS Literacy 2016, with documentation for secondary analysis.
entries.publisher: International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement (IEA); study directed by the TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Boston College

access.auth_note: No registration for public-use files, but downloading requires ticking "I agree to the terms and conditions" (IEA Disclaimer and License Agreement). Restricted-use variables require an application and a non-disclosure agreement.

coverage.spatial: countries and benchmarking entities participating in each PIRLS cycle

entries.license: IEA Terms and conditions and rights of use (non-commercial, educational and research purposes only; redistribution prohibited without IEA's written permission)
entries.attribution: SOURCE: PIRLS (year) Assessment. Copyright © (year) International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement (IEA). Publisher: TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Lynch School of Education, Boston College.
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl and headless Chromium) on IEA's Data Repository. The issue's URL, https://timss-and-pirls.bc.edu/, did not respond. The study center's real host, https://timssandpirls.bc.edu/, answers and mentions the "PIRLS 2026 Field Test". The page describes PIRLS as "directed by the TIMSS and PIRLS International Study Center at Boston College" and "the global standard for assessing trends in reading achievement at the fourth grade". It lists PIRLS 2021 (SAS, SPSS, R), PIRLS 2016, ePIRLS 2016, PIRLS Literacy 2016, PIRLS 2011, "Joint TIMSS & PIRLS 2011", PIRLS 2006 and PIRLS 2001 (SAS, SPSS). Access is the same as for TIMSS (see iea-timss-international-database): a click-through agreement, no account, and restricted-use files on application. It is catalogued separately because the study and repository page are separate. The files were not opened.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: as for TIMSS, the repository's terms link https://www.iea.nl/sites/default/files/2019-05/Disclaimer%20and%20License%20Agreement.pdf. It says "All publications and restricted use items by TIMSS, PIRLS, other IEA studies, and IEA ... are for non-commercial, educational and research purposes only", and that "Commercial exploitation, distribution, redistribution, reproduction ... are prohibited unless written permission has been provided by IEA".

entries.title: IEA TIMSS International Database (Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study)
entries.description: Student, teacher, school and home microdata and achievement scores from IEA's TIMSS assessments of mathematics and science at grades 4 and 8, every four years from 1995 to 2023, with documentation for secondary analysis. TIMSS Longitudinal and TIMSS Advanced data have their own repository pages.
entries.publisher: International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement (IEA); study directed by the TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Boston College

access.auth_note: No registration for public-use files, but downloading requires ticking "I agree to the terms and conditions" (IEA Disclaimer and License Agreement). Restricted-use variables require an application and a non-disclosure agreement.

coverage.spatial: countries and benchmarking entities participating in each TIMSS cycle

entries.license: IEA Terms and conditions and rights of use (non-commercial, educational and research purposes only; redistribution prohibited without IEA's written permission)
entries.attribution: SOURCE: TIMSS (year) Assessment. Copyright © (year) International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement (IEA). Publisher: TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Lynch School of Education, Boston College.
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl and headless Chromium) on IEA's Data Repository. The issue's URL, https://timss-and-pirls.bc.edu/, did not respond (curl status 000; Chromium net::ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED). The study center's real host, https://timssandpirls.bc.edu/, does answer (HTTP 200), and its news points to "The TIMSS 2023 International Database and User Guide ... at timss2023.org/data". This entry catalogues IEA's repository, which holds every cycle. The page says TIMSS is "Directed by the TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center at Boston College" and lists SAS, SPSS and (for 2023) R "Data & Documentation" zips for TIMSS 2023 grades 4 and 8 back to TIMSS 1995, each with a DOI (e.g. https://doi.org/10.58150/IEA_TIMSS_2023_G8_data_edition_1). The TIMSS 2023 grade 8 SPSS zip answered HTTP 200 (about 1.1 GB). The repository's overview says "Data is available in SPSS and SAS, and from PIRLS 2021 onward R formats", and "some variables have been left out from the public use data", with restricted-use files available on application. The files were not opened.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: the repository page says "By accessing the Data Repository and the IDB Analyzer, you indicate that you agree to the terms and conditions", linking https://www.iea.nl/sites/default/files/2019-05/Disclaimer%20and%20License%20Agreement.pdf. That agreement "governs the use of all of IEA's works", and says "All publications and restricted use items by TIMSS, PIRLS, other IEA studies, and IEA ... are for non-commercial, educational and research purposes only". It also says "Commercial exploitation, distribution, redistribution, reproduction ... are prohibited unless written permission has been provided by IEA". The attribution format comes from section 2.2.

entries.title: INEGI — Educational Characteristics of the Population (Mexico)
entries.description: Mexico's national statistics institute's education topic: school attendance, literacy, and educational attainment from the population censuses and intercensal survey, plus enrollment, efficiency, and staffing indicators for the national education system.

entries.license: INEGI Términos de Libre Uso de la Información (free use with attribution)
entries.attribution: Fuente: INEGI, <nombre del producto>
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200, page title "Características educativas de la población". It describes school attendance, literacy, and schooling data, plus "el número de alumnos inscritos en los diferentes niveles educativos, indicadores de eficiencia y sobre los recursos humanos del sistema educativo nacional". It shows a net enrollment rate chart covering 2000-2022. INEGI's terms page (https://www.inegi.org.mx/inegi/terminos.html) allows use under its "Términos de Libre Uso", with attribution in the form "Fuente: INEGI, nombre del producto". The enrollment figures come from the Secretaría de Educación Pública, whose sites (sep.gob.mx, planeacion.sep.gob.mx) and Mejoredu's did not respond this session. API access through INEGI's indicator API wasn't checked.
scripts/check_links.py got HTTP 403 (bot protection) the same day, although a plain curl with a browser user agent and headless Chromium both got HTTP 200. Blocked is not dead; a later probe may report it as blocked.

entries.title: Mexico SEP Formato 911 School Census Statistics (SIGED open data)
entries.description: Open data from the Secretaría de Educación Pública's Formato 911 school census: students, teachers and schools at the start of each school year for basic, upper-secondary (media superior) and higher education, school-level files in CSV and TXT. They are published through SEP's Sistema de Información y Gestión Educativa (SIGED), alongside the DGPPYEE's national statistical publications.
entries.publisher: Secretaría de Educación Pública (SEP), Dirección General de Planeación, Programación y Estadística Educativa (DGPPYEE)

coverage.spatial: Mexico (national, state and school level)
coverage.temporal: school years 2019-2020 to 2024-2025 in the open data files; DGPPYEE historical series back to 1893-1894

entries.license: unverified — no data-specific licence on SIGED or DGPPYEE pages; the linked gob.mx site terms are general and internally inconsistent
entries.attribution: Secretaría de Educación Pública, SIGED, Estadísticos del formato 911
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: SIGED (https://siged.sep.gob.mx/SIGED/) answered HTTP 200 to curl. The open data page and its file list load by JavaScript from api.siged.sep.gob.mx, which answered only in headless Chromium (curl failed), so the vertical should treat this source as headless. www.sep.gob.mx still refused connections (curl failed; Chromium net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET), and mejoredu.gob.mx did not respond. www.planeacion.sep.gob.mx failed in curl but loaded in headless Chromium (HTTP 200). The SIGED "Datos abiertos" page offers "Datos abiertos de alumnado, docentes y escuelas (Formato 911)", INIFED 2013-2018 infrastructure data and the Catálogo de Centros de Trabajo. The Formato 911 list (API group DATABI911) had 48 files, e.g. "Estadísticos del formato 911, educación básica, inicio de cursos ciclo escolar 2024-2025. (En fomato CSV)", updated 03/10/2025. They cover básica, media superior, superior escolarizada and superior no escolarizada, from 2019-2020 to 2024-2025, in CSV and TXT zips. No 2025-2026 file was listed. DGPPYEE's "Estadística educativa" page (https://www.planeacion.sep.gob.mx/estadisticaeducativas.aspx) offers state summaries for "Ciclo 2025-2026" ("Última actualización: Septiembre 2026"), a historical series and forecasts from 1990-1991 to 2030-2031, and national historical statistics "a partir del ciclo escolar 1893-1894". These publications are not covered here beyond the mention. INEGI's education data is catalogued separately as mexico-inegi-caracteristicas-educativas. The zips were not opened.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: neither SIGED nor DGPPYEE states a data licence. SIGED's footer links gob.mx's general "Términos y Condiciones" (https://www.gob.mx/terminos), which say "La información del portal gob.mx es pública a menos que se indique lo contrario" and require citing the electronic location and date of consultation. Elsewhere the same page limits downloads "solamente para su uso personal y no para un uso comercial". They are general and contradictory site terms, so no licence is asserted.

Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl) for OECD's file-server page "PISA Data Files" at webfs.oecd.org. The issue's URL, https://www.oecd.org/en/about/programmes/pisa.html, and the PISA database pages on www.oecd.org returned a Cloudflare "Performing security verification" page (HTTP 403) to curl, headless Chromium and WebFetch. The webfs.oecd.org bare directory (/pisa2022/) also returns 403; only index.html answers. The page lists sections for "PISA 2025", "PISA 2022", 2018, 2015, 2012, 2009, "2009 - ERA", 2006, 2003, 2000 and "PISA for Development". PISA 2025 offers SPSS files (school, student, teacher, cognitive item, cognitive process, questionnaire timing and LDW cognitive), and the foreign language assessment files are marked "(April 2027)". The PISA 2025 student file (…/pisa2022/2025/CY09_MS_STU_PUF.zip) answered HTTP 200, about 993 MB, last-modified 24 Aug 2026. PISA 2022 and earlier offer SAS and SPSS, and the rescaled ESCS trend indices are "available in CSV only". OECD's PISA International Data Explorer (https://pisadataexplorer.oecd.org/ide/idepisa/) also answered HTTP 200 for online tabulation. The files were not opened.
Licence checked 2026-11-01: not verified. OECD's terms page, https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html, was blocked as above, and the PISA Data Files page shows no licence text. No licence is asserted.

The page links a data catalogue and API documentation and states "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated". Each official statistics release has its own schedule, so cadence is event. auth_required: false assumes the public API needs no key; a steward should confirm it.

entries.title: UNESCO LLECE ERCE 2019 Regional Learning Assessment Databases
entries.description: Student, teacher, family and school databases from ERCE 2019 (Estudio Regional Comparativo y Explicativo), the fourth regional learning assessment of primary students in Latin America and the Caribbean. It was run by UNESCO's Latin American Laboratory for Assessment of the Quality of Education (LLECE) in 16 countries, and the databases come with codebooks, questionnaires and a user manual.
entries.publisher: UNESCO Regional Bureau for Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (OREALC/UNESCO Santiago), Latin American Laboratory for Assessment of the Quality of Education (LLECE)

coverage.spatial: 16 Latin American and Caribbean countries (Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Cuba, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Dominican Republic, Uruguay)

entries.license: unverified — no data-specific licence on the ERCE page; UNESCO's site-wide Terms of use allow only occasional non-commercial educational and research reproduction where no specific licence applies
entries.attribution: UNESCO OREALC/LLECE, Estudio Regional Comparativo y Explicativo (ERCE 2019)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-11-01: HTTP 200 (curl with a browser User-Agent; headless Chromium got net::ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE from www.unesco.org this session). The LLECE description page named in the issue (https://www.unesco.org/es/fieldoffice/santiago/expertise/llece) says LLECE "ha puesto a disposición bases de datos" and links "Más información" to the ERCE 2019 article catalogued here (published 9 March 2023, "Última actualización: 31 de Agosto de 2026"). That page has a section "Bases de datos del cuarto Estudio Regional Comparativo y Explicativo (ERCE 2019)" with links to "Bases de datos (zip)", "Libros de código (zip)", "Cuestionarios (zip)" and a PDF "Manual de uso de las bases de datos". The links go to UNESCO's SharePoint (unesco.sharepoint.com/s/SantiagoTeam). curl was redirected to a Microsoft login, but headless Chromium opened the shared "1. Bases de datos-20220726T214504Z-001.zip" anonymously (folder dated 2022-06-17). The page says ERCE 2019 "se aplicó desde mayo de 2019 en 16 países" and covered "más de 4.000 escuelas y más de 160.000 niños", and that TERCE 2013 comparability was maintained. It also links an "ERCE 2025" fifth-cycle project page, whose data were not looked for. Data file formats inside the zips weren't checked, and neither were the earlier cycles (PERCE, SERCE, TERCE).
Licence checked 2026-11-01: the ERCE page shows "Attribution 3.0 IGO (CC BY 3.0 IGO)" only as the credit for its header photo, not for the data. UNESCO's general Terms of use (https://www.unesco.org/en/terms-use, last update 15 September 2026) say "Where a Material is made available under an Intergovernmental Organization (IGO) Creative Commons license or other specific license, the User may use that Material in accordance with the terms of that license". Otherwise users "may consult, cite, translate and reproduce individual Materials, on an occasional and individual basis, for personal use and for non-commercial educational and research purposes, with proper attribution to UNESCO". Section 8 reserves text-and-data-mining rights. These are site-wide terms, not a data licence, so the data licence is left unverified.

Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200. The page describes "An annual report that presents data collected from the Pupil Level Annual School Census, with additional information on the schools and their teachers and support staff". It shows "First published: 24 July 2014", "Last updated: 5 August 2026", and the latest release, "Schools' census results: January 2026". Reachability is touchy. On 2026-10-31 a browser-UA curl got HTTP 200 (once after 11 s, once in 0.3 s), a curl with no user agent got HTTP 403, and scripts/check_links.py timed out at its 12 s limit. A link-checker flag on this entry may be slowness or bot filtering rather than a dead page.
Licence checked 2026-10-31: the Welsh Government copyright statement (https://www.gov.wales/copyright-statement), linked from the footers of the release page and of StatsWales, says "You may use and re-use the information featured in this website (not including logos) free of charge in any format or medium, under the terms of the Open Government Licence", linking OGL v3.
